g.title: frag_micro_nn_distance → elong_micro_axis_alignment intra_scale A fish with larger nearest-neighbor spacing has weaker local social constraint from nearby schoolmates; over subsequent steps its heading may be less entrained by the group's principal axis, so its absolute axis alignment can change. This is a dynamic micro-level candidate effect rather than a definitional aggregation.

elong_meso_local_eigen_ratio → frag_meso_contact_component_count intra_scale Anisotropic local contact-neighborhood geometry can reflect stretching along one direction that breaks lateral contacts; as local neighborhoods become more elongated, the contact graph may later split into more components. This is a plausible meso-level dynamic relation mediated by changing contacts, not a direct aggregation of the same quantity.

elong_macro_global_eigen_ratio → frag_macro_largest_component_fraction intra_scale Greater global position elongation spreads fish along a major axis and can push some pairwise distances beyond contact range, which may reduce the fraction of fish remaining in the largest contact component. The candidate effect is mediated by contact formation and is not a definitional identity between the two macro indicators.

N1 | frag_micro_nn_distance Focal fish nearest-neighbor distance Scale: micro | Phenomenon: school_fragmentation Definition: For run r and step t, let V_t={i: role_i(t)='fish'}. For i in V_t, d_i(t)=min_{j in V_t, j!=i} sqrt((x_i(t)-x_j(t))^2+(y_i(t)-y_j(t))^2). If |V_t|<2, d_i(t)=NaN. Execution: {'2a815b4dfe4f47b8ac2416fac04456e5': {'status': 'success', 'series_file': 'indicator_series/2a815b4dfe4f47b8ac2416fac04456e5/frag_micro_nn_distance.parquet', 'series_sha256': '3b312a81989834692e765b861953bf4b9777d72a81fc4c895e38399e387bb2c4'}}

N4 | elong_micro_axis_alignment Focal fish heading alignment with group principal axis Scale: micro | Phenomenon: school_elongation Definition: For run r and step t, let V_t={i: role_i(t)='fish'}. Let mu(t)=(1/|V_t|) sum_{j in V_t} p_j(t) and Sigma(t)=(1/(|V_t|-1)) sum_{j in V_t} (p_j(t)-mu(t))(p_j(t)-mu(t))^T with p_j=(x_j,y_j). Let lambda1>=lambda2 be eigenvalues of Sigma(t) and u1(t) a unit eigenvector for lambda1. For i in V_t, h_i(t)=(cos heading_i(t), sin heading_i(t)); a_i(t)=|h_i(t) dot u1(t)|. If |V_t|<3 or lambda1=lambda2, set a_i(t)=NaN. N2 | frag_meso_contact_component_count Fish contact-graph component count Scale: meso | Phenomenon: school_fragmentation Definition: At (r,t), build G_t=(V_t,E_t) with V_t={i: role_i(t)='fish'} and E_t={{i,j}: i,j in V_t, i!=j, and (agent_id=i, partner_id=j) or (agent_id=j, partner_id=i) appears in contacts at (r,t)}. Let C_1(t),...,C_{K(t)}(t) be the connected components of G_t. K(t)=number of components. Execution: {'2a815b4dfe4f47b8ac2416fac04456e5': {'status': 'success', 'series_file': 'indicator_series/2a815b4dfe4f47b8ac2416fac04456e5/frag_meso_contact_component_count.parquet', 'series_sha256': '4cf060754c76c46cddf0dad5ff306bca23e6bc940786dc3b57db2221359e5811'}}

N5 | elong_meso_local_eigen_ratio Mean contact-neighborhood elongation ratio Scale: meso | Phenomenon: school_elongation Definition: At (r,t), for fish i let N_i(t)={j: {i,j} in E_t} and S_i(t)={i} union N_i(t). If |S_i(t)|>=3 and lambda2_i(t)>0, define R_i(t)=lambda1_i(t)/lambda2_i(t) from the sample covariance of positions in S_i(t). The meso indicator is the mean of R_i(t) over eligible i.
